zh: 终点只取决于 U、D、L、R 各自的数量，与顺序无关；任何到达同一终点的走法至少需要曼哈顿距离那么多步。
必须保留的只有净竖直位移 |U − D| 和净水平位移 |L − R| 对应的移动，其余方向相反的移动都可以成对删除。
统计四种字符的个数，答案为指令总长度减去 |U − D| 再减去 |L − R|。
en: The endpoint depends only on how many U, D, L, and R moves there are, not on their order; any route to the same endpoint needs at least the Manhattan distance in steps.
Only the moves that make up the net vertical displacement |U − D| and the net horizontal displacement |L − R| must stay; all other moves cancel in opposite pairs and can be deleted.
Count the four letters; the answer is the total length minus |U − D| minus |L − R|.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Keep the necessary net vertical and net horizontal displacement, and delete the remaining opposite moves in pairs.

## Proof of correctness

Any path reaching the same endpoint needs at least the Manhattan distance |U−D|+|L−R| steps. After deleting the UD pairs and the LR pairs, the number of remaining instructions is exactly this distance and the endpoint is unchanged, so the lower bound is reached.

## Complexity

O(n) time and O(1) extra space.
